questions.question: What sweet comes in every flavor, including the awful ones?
questions.note: Dumbledore eats one on the train in the first film and gets a bad flavor. Harry tries them on the Hogwarts Express.

questions.question: What sport is played on broomsticks with a Quaffle, Bludgers, and a Snitch?
questions.note: Harry plays Seeker. The World Cup visit is in the fourth film, though the match itself is not shown.

questions.question: What village can third-years and up visit on certain weekends?
questions.note: Honeydukes and the Three Broomsticks are there. Butterbeer is the drink. Harry cannot go until he has a signed permission form.

questions.question: What is Hagrid's job when Harry first arrives at Hogwarts?
questions.note: He introduces himself that way in the hut. He starts teaching Care of Magical Creatures in the third film.

questions.question: Who teaches Charms?
questions.note: He stands on a pile of books to be seen over the desk. Wingardium Leviosa is his lesson.

questions.question: Who teaches Herbology?
questions.note: Her greenhouse holds the mandrakes. She is head of Hufflepuff.

questions.question: What is the main wizarding newspaper?
questions.note: It turns on Harry in the fifth film and calls him a liar. The Quibbler is Luna's father's paper, not the mainstream one.

questions.question: What does Hagrid ride through the sky when he delivers baby Harry to Privet Drive?
questions.note: The bike is Sirius's. Hagrid flies it again in the seven Potters escape, with a sidecar.

questions.question: What stone basin lets you step into someone else's memory?
questions.note: Dumbledore keeps one in his office. Harry sees the Death Eater trials in it, then Slughorn's memory, then Snape's.

questions.question: Who teaches the first-years their first flying lesson?
questions.note: Yellow eyes, short grey hair, whistle. Neville breaks his wrist. She also referees Quidditch.
